function.name: dealer_get_details
function.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific dealer including name, address, contact, products carried, and license status. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT verify license — use dealer_verify_license. Data may be stale or contain inconsistencies. Fails if dealer_id invalid.

function.name: dealer_filter_by_product
function.description: Filters dealers by product type and crop compatibility. Returns dealers that carry matching products. PUBLIC tool. Location is required. Does NOT verify dealer status or product availability. Fails if location missing, crop_type unsupported, or no matches found.
